title: National Science Day — The Trial of Abdus Salam
teaser: National Science Day 2026: tAcT and Seed2Sapling Education sponsored 16 teachers from across Karnataka to attend the science play "The Trial of Abdus Salam" at Rangashankara, Bengaluru.
homepageMatter: On National Science Day 2026, tAcT and Seed2Sapling Education (sponsored by Ridhdhi Foundation) brought 16 teachers and educators from across Karnataka to see the science play "The Trial of Abdus Salam" at Rangashankara, Bengaluru.
